title: Jesus / Son Research Index
purpose: Provide one durable entry point for the project's Jesus/Son research so biography, care/healing, prison, recognition, Passion prehistory, hand-over, spectacle, commodification, table-flipping, typed death-transitions, nourishment/seed/knowledge, Thomas, Lamb/Lion, Door/Cornerstone and Father/Son reciprocity are discoverable as one connected field rather than scattered files.

entry_sequence.use: Identity boundary and year-by-year Son timeline.
Long developmental genealogy and pre-Christian/Christian precursor strata; ordinary lived substrates before later theology.
Distinguish physical survival, ego-death, confinement, persona death, social/personhood death, meme-cross, burial/seed-death and return so they are not flattened into one resurrection motif.
Claim-by-claim source status and unresolved attribution questions.
Dense 2016 prison/Yahya/inmate Jesus-Lamb recognition, witness, scripture and confessional sequence.

Specialist 2017-2019 corridor: Josh Moon declaration, anti-martyr/nameless-faceless reply, return vow, Farm/objectification, hand-over and sale grammars, provisional table-flip, persona death and meme-cross approach.
2018 old-persona/shadow-death specialist layer; Pauline old-self/new-self comparisons kept separate from later crucifixion and seed death.
Full-life Jesus/Son comparison from early care and healing through prison, recognition, Passion prehistory, crucifixion imagery, Thomas, grain, cornerstone, Door and Father relation.

Tracks sacrifice-food, self-as-food, Son/Bread, body-as-knowledge, Communion, planting/multiplication and Christ-as-Bread-inside-Potato while separating Eucharist, seed and revelation-ingestion lanes.
Father/Son/Door relational architecture: source, manifestation, threshold, asymmetry, mutual dependence and Johannine unity/distinction comparators.
Later Tim/Father relation and Godhood question kept separate from the Son's historical biography.

nourishment_and_ingestion: I am a Potato. Eat me

high_value_questions: What is the earliest recoverable instance of someone else calling the Son Jesus?
Can the exact Yahya Hassan wording, reported witnesses and prison location/date be further recovered, and when was the Yahya=John-the-Baptist onomastic relation first noticed?
What is the earliest dated instance of the Son himself saying 'I am Jesus Christ' or asking to be crucified?
Does the original Josh Moon recording, transcript or chat log survive, and what is the exact wording/date?
What is the fullest recoverable wording of Moon's remembered anti-martyr / nameless-faceless / lolcow reply?
What is the earliest dated source for the Son's promise to return publicly every day/forever?
Can the original table-flipping post, recording or conversation be recovered, and was it actually in 2018?
Who were the actors referred to as 'they' in the table-flipping recollection, rather than assuming every function belonged to Josh Moon or Kiwi Farms?
When do sell/sold, slave/slavery, farm/farming, traffic/trafficking and groom/grooming first appear, and which are metaphor, allegation, event-description or later theology?
Does the pre-meme-cross table-flip chronology genuinely parallel the Synoptic Temple-cleansing-before-Passion sequence once dates are recovered?
How do Joseph's sale/descent pattern and the Passion's hand-over/betrayal pattern differ in explanatory value for the Son chronology?
Can the 2007-versus-2009 nursing-home date conflict be resolved, and can the original witnesses/medical context for the walking and glaucoma stories be recovered?
Can the 2018 essence/persona death be sourced contemporaneously, and does its earliest wording support old-self/new-self comparison before later meme-cross theology?
When does the grain-of-wheat-in-the-heart motif first appear relative to the meme death?
When does Thomas/Didymus/Twin first become attached to the Son?
When does rejected-stone/cornerstone language first appear?
When does the Son first become Door/Vessel rather than merely a person?
When does self-as-food language first appear, and how does it develop into Son/Bread, body-as-knowledge, Communion and planting/multiplication?
Can the exact July 2026 body-as-knowledge conversation be recovered and compared with earlier public formulations?
When does Father/Son relational necessity first become explicit, rather than simple Father-above/Son-below hierarchy?
How much of the Passion comparison existed before the 2019/2020 death corridor, and how much is retrospective synthesis?
Which parallels become stronger because several functions occur in one dated event-field, and which disappear when provenance is checked?
interpretive_rule: The strongest project argument is chronological, relational and source-directional: identify what existed before later interpretation; preserve co-occurring functions and exact interlocutors; distinguish different kinds of death/transition; then show how later events reorganized earlier material. Do not reduce dense sequences to one-word coincidences, do not convert resemblance into proof of supernatural identity, do not convert project allegations into external facts, and do not let attractive assistant-generated details outrank sourced biography.
public_reader_summary: The project studies an accumulating Jesus/Son pattern rather than a single identity claim: early lived substrates of care, repair and rupture; institutional conflict; imprisonment and scripture; reported Yahya/John-name-role Jesus-Lamb recognition with witnesses; a later explicit Jesus/crucifixion challenge to Joshua Moon; hesitation and a remembered anti-martyr attempt to reduce the Son to a nameless/faceless public object; a vow of continual return; resistance to being farmed or commodified; a provisionally dated pre-meme-cross table-flipping episode; a distinct 2018 persona/shadow death; and finally the unresolved 2019/2020 meme-death/burial corridor, Thomas/Twin, grain/seed, Door/Cornerstone and Father-Son architecture. Separate research tracks now distinguish death-types, old-self/new-self transformation, nourishment/body/knowledge, seed/multiplication and Father-Son-Door reciprocity so the archive can become denser without becoming less precise.
